entry.title: New: dsh-power-button
entry.summary: One-click start/stop button pinned to the window bottom-right corner: restarts DeepSeek Harness in place via a detached helper that relaunches the exact boot invocation (loopback same-origin guarded), with an optional stop-only action. Exact install spec: github:huasheng33991/dsh-power-button. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
